subject: Post-demo performance & SLO recap — latency/throughput targets (Decision criteria & MAP)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-demo performance & SLO recap — latency/throughput targets (Decision criteria & MAP)

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and appreciate the detailed walkthrough of your end-to-end flow. I wanted to capture the performance details we discussed so we have a clear checklist for the next steps and MAP items.

Quick recap from the demo (what we observed / you asked about):
- Demo model: open-variant v2 (quantized) on g4dn-equivalent nodes
- Observed P95 latency: ~150ms for ~120-token generation (streaming enabled)
- Sustained throughput during demo: ~45k tokens/sec
- Concurrency during demo: peak ~180 concurrent requests
- Streaming: live partial tokens (client receives chunks) — you confirmed streaming is required

Your stated targets / requirements:
- Latency: P95 <= 200ms for 512-token responses
- Concurrency: baseline 250 rps, burst to 400 rps for short windows
- Throughput: sustained ~60k tokens/sec across region
- Streaming: required (chunked partial responses + low tail latency)
- Regional availability: US (multi-AZ) to start, EU later

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm the traffic profile (avg request size, % of streaming calls, peak window duration) — see checklist attached (post-demo-slo-checklist.pdf).
2) We’ll scope a short PoC run (2–4 hours) with a synthetic traffic profile approximating your peak to validate latency/concurrency and gather billing/cost estimates. Logan will own the PoC setup from our side.
3) We'll draft a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones (PoC, security review, commercial terms). I’ve attached a first-pass MAP workbook (redwood_map_v1.xlsx) and linked a Drive folder.

Action items for FintechCo:
- Share a small sample dataset and an API key for test traffic (or provide temporary endpoint config)
- Confirm ideal/acceptable test window next week
- Confirm decision criteria beyond latency (cost per token target, support SLA, data residency)

I’ll follow up with a proposed MAP and a PoC run-book once you confirm the above.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Marissa —

Thanks for the succinct recap, that matches what we took away. Quick answers to your checklist items:
- Traffic profile: avg request payload ~120 tokens; 25% of calls are streaming in our UX; peak sustained windows typically last 30–45 minutes during batch jobs; spikes can be up to 400 concurrent requests for a few minutes
- Sample data: attaching a small anonymized sample (coming in separate secure upload) — we can provide a short-lived test key for the PoC
- Decision criteria: primary is P95 latency <=200ms, secondary is TCO (we're targeting $X/token as a ballpark — will share a budget range in the next email), tertiary is commercial SLAs and support coverage

For the PoC, we prefer next Wednesday (6/6) or Thursday (6/7) morning PT — 2-hour window to start. Can Redwood provide expected pricing for a 2-hour PoC and an estimate for a month-long baseline if we move forward?

Appreciate it — Priya and I will review the MAP when you send it.

—Alex

Alex / Priya —

Forwarding the thread — thanks for the productive demo. A couple of points from the executive side to confirm decision criteria so legal/commercial can scope appropriately: 

Decision criteria (to be evaluated after PoC):
- Performance: P95 latency <= 200ms (512 tokens) across the US region
- Reliability: error rate < 0.1% during sustained windows
- Throughput: demonstrable sustained tokens/sec ~60k with ability to burst
- Streaming: support for chunked partial responses with <50ms median chunk latency
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence and KMS for key management
- Cost: within your stated budget bucket (we expect a target range; Alex to share)

Operational ask: we require a short PoC (2 hours) with your test dataset; please confirm you can provide temporary test credentials and a post-run report that aligns metrics to decision criteria above.

Marissa / Logan: please coordinate and share a PoC run-book and expected times by EOD today so FintechCo can lock the window.

Best,
